C1.worst_defect: The home page says what it is ('Point of sale for Vendure', 'Pre-release · plugin 0.3.0') but never says who it is for, who should not use it, or how it differs from Shopify POS, Square or the Vendure admin. A sceptic comparing tills gets no 'not for you if…' line.
C1.where: home.desktop.01-02 (hero and 'What it does today'); no such section on any page

C2.worst_defect: 'MIT licensed' is repeated in the home footer and on Overview, but 'Before you start' and Limitations also require an 'RxDB Premium licence token (RXDB_PREMIUM)' to build or self-host the till. The site never says what that licence costs, or that the open-source build depends on it. No maintainer, company or support channel is named, and the changelog shows nothing shipped since 0.3.0 on 2026-10-06.
C2.where: home.desktop.02 'Before you start' + footer; limitations; changelog

C3.worst_defect: A known plugin bug is documented as a manual step instead of being fixed: 'On plugin 0.3.0 the role it creates (vendurepos-pos-till) has the step 4 permissions except ReadOrder, so add ReadOrder…' appears in quick-start and twice in connect-a-till. The live demo also shows refunds at the till, which 'No, not on plugin 0.3.0' says a real store cannot do.
C3.where: quick-start step 4; connect-a-till; home 'Live demo or your own store' table

C4.worst_defect: Quick-start step 8 item h ('Once the order has synced, check Vendure for the POS prices, settled tally-pos payment…') is repeated word for word in the 'Check it worked.' list right below it. The changelog uses internal jargon a buyer cannot read: 'ADR 0005', '#116', 'order.create v5', 'TallyPosV51790900000000'. Limitations is 15 flat, ungrouped bullets.

C5.worst_defect: On tall desktop docs pages the left sidebar's grey panel stops at about y=900 and the plain page background carries on below it. The docs nav also lists both 'Docs' and 'Overview', which point to the same page.

C6.worst_defect: The phone header shows only a search icon and a sidebar toggle, so 'Docs' and 'Live demo' are hidden behind the toggle on every page. Code blocks wrap instead of scrolling, which breaks import lines mid-path.

C7.worst_defect: Searching for 'offline' returns troubleshooting, quick-start, docs and at-the-till, but not the home page or limitations, where the offline claim and its limits are stated. Every sitemap lastmod is the 2026-11-17/18 build time, not the date the content changed.

overall_worst.defect: The site sells itself as 'MIT licensed' open source, but building or self-hosting the till needs a paid 'RxDB Premium licence token (RXDB_PREMIUM)'. The site never says what that costs, who it is bought from, or that hosted use avoids it. With no named maintainer or support channel and no release in six weeks, a sceptic would warn a client off on the licence point alone.
overall_worst.where: home.desktop.02 'Before you start' + home footer 'MIT licensed'; limitations
overall_worst.fix: Next to 'Before you start' and in Limitations, add one plain paragraph: what RxDB Premium is, what it costs, that it is needed only to build or self-host and not to use app.vendurepos.com, and whether an open fallback is planned. Add a 'Who maintains this / where to get help' line to the footer.
